title: License Application
source_file: View Policy LICN-004_ License Application _ NC State Board of Education.html

blocks.text: Policy Statement
This Policy establishes the required components of an application for a license.
Policy
Any applicant for professional educator license shall complete an application that includes the following information and credentials for the applicant:
Full Legal Name.
blocks.label: (a)

blocks.text: United States Social Security Number.
blocks.label: (b)

blocks.text: Date of Birth.
blocks.label: (c)

blocks.text: Physical Mailing Address.
blocks.label: (d)

blocks.text: Telephone Number.
blocks.label: (e)

blocks.text: Personal Email Address.
blocks.label: (f)

blocks.text: Educational credentials, including:
blocks.label: (g)

blocks.text: Official transcripts for any degree obtained from an institution of higher or educator preparation program; and
blocks.label: (i)

blocks.text: Documentation, signed by an official authorized by the EPP to provide such information, verifying that the applicant has completed an EPP for the classification of license sought by the applicant.
blocks.label: (ii)

blocks.text: A statement and supporting documentation disclosing the following information:
blocks.label: (h)

blocks.text: Any prior suspension or revocation of a professional certificate or license issued by an occupational licensing board in North Carolina or any other state; and
blocks.label: (i)

blocks.text: Any criminal history not previously expunged in accordance with Chapter 15A, Article 5 of the General Statutes, including:
blocks.label: (ii)

blocks.text: Pending or dismissed charges;
blocks.label: (A)

blocks.text: Deferred prosecution agreements or similar prosecutorial agreements, the terms of which have not yet been fulfilled by the applicant; and
blocks.label: (B)

blocks.text: Convictions, as defined in LICN-007, Subsection 2(b).
blocks.label: (C)

blocks.text: Proof of any current and valid educator license or certificate issued by another state, if applicable.
blocks.label: (i)

blocks.text: Proof of certification by the National Board for Professional Teaching Standards, if applicable.
blocks.label: (j)

blocks.text: If the applicant is seeking experience credit for prior work experience, documentation that the applicant meets the applicable requirements in LICN-006.
blocks.label: (k)

blocks.text: Documentation of performance on any applicable licensure examination requirements.
blocks.label: (l)

blocks.text: The applicant shall pay the applicable application fee as defined in LICN-008.
